Screens — PDP (Figma page 581:11523) geometry check

Loads each screen in a same-origin iframe and compares the root frame size and the position and size of major sections with the Figma metadata in docs/figma-audit/raw/metadata/581-11523.xml. Positions are relative to the frame's outer top-left corner. Tolerance: 1px. Serve the project root over HTTP.
